title: leaf.surface-config.v1
description: Per-surface-id PARTIAL of the contract slots web/src/site/productSurfaces.js declares (chrome.*, toolbar.*, rails.*, commandLine, authoring, versions, conversations.scope, builds.routes, contextMenu, groundMaterial.*, plus chrome.tab from slice 5b). productSurfaces.js is the ENUM source of truth; this schema was authored from slice7-spec.md's slot list because that file lives in the leaf-web-demo repo, which this schema's mushy-code lane cannot read (separate lane, separate PR). The leaf-web-demo half pins byte-for-byte equality between the two by test. An overlay supplies a SUBSET of a surface's slots (every slot is optional); an unknown surface id or an unknown slot name fails the WHOLE file closed (additionalProperties:false at the surface-id and slot-name levels), never a partial merge.

authoring.description: Mirrors surfaceContract(id).authoring (slice 7a): whether the workspace rail's Author tab mounts for this surface.

tab.description: The slice-5b chrome tab id (e.g. the fifth 'sheets' tab).

chromeSlot.$comment: chrome carries more fields in productSurfaces.js than this schema enumerates (title, icon, and similar); only chrome.tab is named by the slice-7 spec text this schema was authored from. Widening this object to the full chrome.* shape needs a read of productSurfaces.js, which is out of this lane's reach; the leaf-web-demo half pins full equality by test.

genericSlotObject.$comment: toolbar / rails / commandLine / versions / contextMenu / groundMaterial: named as slots by the slice-7 spec, but their interior field shape lives in productSurfaces.js, which is out of this lane's reach. Typed as an object (bounded by the fold's overall size cap) rather than additionalProperties:false, pending the leaf-web-demo half's test-pinned equality.
